name: HZ_CUST_ACCOUNTS
description: The HZ_CUST_ACCOUNTS table stores information about customer accounts , or business relationships that the deploying company establishes with a party of type Organization or Person. This table focuses on business relationships and how transactions are conducted in the relationship. Since a party can have multiple customer accounts, this table might contain several records for a single party.  For example, an individual person can establish a personal account, family account, and a professional account for a consulting practice.

columns.name: CUST_ACCOUNT_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the account created for a Party. Primary Key for the table

columns.name: PARTY_ID
columns.description: A foreign key to the HZ_PARTY table.

columns.name: ORIG_SYSTEM_REFERENCE
columns.description: Unique customer identifier from foreign or legacy system

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Customer status flag.  Lookup code for CODE_STATUS

columns.name: CUSTOMER_TYPE
columns.description: Receivables lookup code for the CUSTOMER_TYPE attribute. I for internal customers, R for revenue generating external customers.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_CLASS_CODE
columns.description: Customer class indentifier. For example, an account created fir a reseller or educational customers would have a customer_class_code as reseller or education.

columns.name: TAX_CODE
columns.description: Tax Code for the Customer

columns.name: TAX_HEADER_LEVEL_FLAG
columns.description: Indicate if item is tax header or a line item. Y for records that are headers for tax purposes, N for records that are lines.

columns.name: TAX_ROUNDING_RULE
columns.description: Tax amount rounding rule

columns.name: COTERMINATE_DAY_MONTH

columns.name: HELD_BILL_EXPIRATION_DATE
columns.description: Held bill expiration date

columns.name: HOLD_BILL_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the bill receivable should be held or not. Y for holding the bill, N for bills receivable should not be held.

columns.name: ACCOUNT_NAME

columns.name: DEPOSIT_REFUND_METHOD
columns.description: Refund Method

columns.name: NPA_NUMBER
columns.description: Identifies an account with a Number Plan Area (NPA) used in telecommunications.

columns.name: SOURCE_CODE
columns.description: Promotion that was used to make the party a customer

columns.name: COMMENTS
columns.description: Free format information about the customer

columns.name: DATE_TYPE_PREFERENCE
columns.description: Preference for ship or arrival dates

columns.name: ARRIVALSETS_INCLUDE_LINES_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if lines include arrival sets. Y for lines included on arrival sets, N for lines not automatically included in arrival sets

columns.name: STATUS_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Last status update date

columns.name: AUTOPAY_FLAG
columns.description: Autopay flag

columns.name: LAST_BATCH_ID
columns.description: Last active batch

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY_MODULE
columns.description: TCA Who column

columns.name: SELLING_PARTY_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the party entering a business relationship as a seller. A selling party can be an individual or an organization. The Selling Party represents the external facing organization with which the customer is doing business, and is not necessarily a Legal Entity or Operating Unit. Its usage within the ebusiness suite will be phased: Phase 1:Products can join to HZ_PARTIES using the SELLING_PARTY_ID to retrieve the PARTY_NAME for use in a UI. eg a call center application may run on behalf of several internal organizations - displaying the selling party will allow the user to see context for the customer Phase 2:Products can use SELLING_PARTY_ID as a filtering mechanism.  eg a profile controls the selling_party_id that a user has access to.  The UI would then show accounts matching this party.

columns.name: CONFLICT_ID
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: this value is used to guarantee the uniqueness of the row when duplicates are created in different databases (i.e. mobile databases or the server).

columns.name: USER_LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row. This value is different from LAST_UPDATE_DATE if the update originally happened in a different database (i.e. a different mobile database or the server).
